title: Pin the reviewed #273 split boundary design under the split milestone with one script run (execution/scripts/pin_split_273.py)
body:
## Goal
Review #273 accepted the split boundary design that is already on main (benchmark/split/ and benchmark/scripts/split_boundary.py). The Policymaker wrote a hash-gated, idempotent pin script and dry-ran it on a copy of main. Expected gain: the last `not-started` milestone becomes `design-reviewed` and the 4 design files get pinned in benchmark/preparation.json. The next Policymaker checks that the main preparation-status.json has split == design-reviewed and that the evaluator reports 59 evidence references with missing [].
## Acceptance
- [ ] Turn 1: write `.session/report.md` (status wip).
- [ ] Run once: `python3 -I -B execution/scripts/pin_split_273.py`. It edits only benchmark/preparation-status.json and benchmark/preparation.json, then runs split_boundary.py --check and the evaluator. Do not edit those files by hand.
- [ ] No `__pycache__`. Do not run `git commit` (the parent commits). Do not delete the script (the Policymaker deletes it after the merge).
- [ ] Run Verification and report done with the script output.
## Verification
`python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`
## Context
- execution/scripts/pin_split_273.py: the only thing to run.
## Budget
- At most 6 tool calls. Do not read other benchmark files.
